Magento Services By Mobilunity’s Engineers

Magento Development Services

eCommerce Development for B2B and B2C Stores

Create stunning virtual stores for businesses of different scale and individual projects with Mobilunity’s e-commerce adepts. Our developers have extensive experience and a deep understanding of industry standards for e-commerce projects.

Development of Magento-Based Marketplaces

Introduce better scalability and flexibility, fast loading and responsiveness, and improved security and high performance to your marketplace. With our programmers, you can support multiple vendors and stores and access CMS functionality and diverse plugins.

Headless PWA Development

Boost the performance of your Magento solution and enhance user experience with the headless architecture our developers build for you. They’ll experience shorter development cycles and ensure faster time-to-market of your app.

Development of Adobe Commerce Apps

Expand your business with robust, user-friendly, and functional apps on the latest Magento version. Mobilunity’s dedicated team of Magento developers will build feature-rich mobile and browser-based applications that will promote your brand.

Customization Services

Theme Development and Design Customization

Whether you need to implement a consistent visual design for your PWAs or want to improve the layout of your current solution, hire a Magento theme developer with deep expertise to customize the templates, images, styles, and more.

Custom Magento Solutions

Engage professional expertise to enhance your online store with the development of diverse plugins and additional modules. Add greater business value, get competitive advantages, and grow your ROI with Mobilunity’s tech adepts.

Payment Gateway Solutions

Pick Google Pay/Apple Pay, Amazon Payments, Paypal, Stripe, or several payment methods, and our skilled web developers will swiftly integrate them into your website. Make payments flexible and convenient for your customers.

Add many different custom shipping options to your e-store, offering your buyers diverse checkout and unique customer experience. Engage our developers to select delivery companies and configure shipping parameters according to your policies.

Cloud Services

Leverage the most advanced and rich features available on Magento hosting platform with our tech expertise. Improved security, pre-configured environment, and automatic deployment are only a few of the benefits you can achieve with Mobilunity.

Integration of Add-Ons into Magento Cloud Solutions

Our engineers will add Magento extensions to your cloud-based e-shop to automate tasks, improve user experience, monitor taxes, minimize cart abandonment, connect to your CRM, etc.

Integration & Conversion Services

Transform static PSD into a responsive virtual store with Mobilunity’s tech professionals. They boast a high level of proficiency, from designing your ecommerce store in Photoshop to splitting, converting, and integrating files into your shopping platform’s UI.

Customized Magento Platform Extensions

Pack your online shop with advanced add-ons that enrich its functionality. Our specialists will create custom modules following specific coding standards and ensure seamless integration.

API Development

Customize checkout, improve product management, and add real-time features with APIs our certified Adobe Commerce developers create for your apps. They let you make informed decisions, minimize human errors, secure payments, optimize revenues, and more.

{other services}

Other Magento Services

Support & Maintenance of E-Commerce Websites and Apps

Mobilunity’s engineers handle data recovery, backups, timely updates, and tech support. They reinforce the security and monitor upgrade releases to keep your Magento store optimized for conversion.

Data Backup & Security

Keep your customers’ trust high with the help of our disaster recovery and cybersecurity talents. Skilled Magento engineers will run regular backups and identify website vulnerabilities according to your company’s needs and specifics to prevent data breaches or losses.

Magento Migration and Upgrade

Let our tech adepts upgrade your Magento 1 to Magento 2, move your Adobe Commerce app to another server, or migrate your store to Magento 2 to serve more customers simultaneously. Hire certified Magento developers from us to grow customer satisfaction and conversion rates.

E-Commerce SEO Solutions

Improve your online visibility, drive traffic to your website, and engage qualified leads with the SEO service our Adobe Commerce engineers offer. Let them optimize your product pages, implement simple URL structures, and add schema markups for higher ranking. 

Grow Your E-Commerce Conversion Rate with Top Magento Engineers!

Why Work With Mobilunity

Because of Mobilunity’s global reach, you can hire Magento web developers with significant cost savings compared to contracting developers locally. At the same time, we optimize our cooperation model for your business needs and charge moderate administrative costs.

While our vetted Magento experts work on your virtual store, Mobilunity handles all the rest. Our back-office professionals embrace the HR, accounting, legal, and IT helpdesk aspects for your team, freeing you from handling administrative tasks.

100% Functional Control Over Your Team

When building or extending your team with Mobilunity, you contract engineers who are under your complete control. Your PM sets tasks and monitors their completion, while Mobilunity covers back-office support and IT helpdesk for your team.

Individual Approach to Every Client

Strong relationships with clients are one of Mobilunity’s top priorities. We address business specifics and offer individual cooperation models to our 40+ customers. As a result, our client partnerships last for 4.2 years on average.

Focus on Strategic Cooperation

Most clients came to Mobilunity seeking long-term collaboration with outstaffed tech teams. Due to our effective ongoing retention, Mobilunity’s engineers stay on a project for 3 years on average, which makes us a dedicated resource provider.

Contract E-Commerce Engineers with Us

Share as many details about your eCommerce project as possible: tech stack, scope, required roles, preferred team location, cooperation format, and available budget. We’ll discuss estimated costs and, once approved, start sending you CVs.

FAQs on Contracting Magento Developers

How much does it cost to hire a Magento developer?

The cost depends on their expertise level, location, and the cooperation model you choose. Get a cost estimate during a free consultation with Mobilunity’s managers. 

How quickly can you set up a team of certified Magento developers for hire?

Mobilunity’s recruiters need 3-6 weeks to find, vet, interview, and onboard your coders. Meanwhile, this timeframe will depend on your engagement and prompt feedback too.

Does Mobilunity offer e-commerce development services?

Mobilunity isn’t a Magento development company. Instead, we help you engage top-tier engineers to build e-commerce projects of any scope.

Do you offer staff augmentation services?

Of course, once you need Magento ecommerce engineers to extend your team, our professionals are ready to help. Engage remote tech experts full-, part-time, or hourly and scale up or down anytime.

Do you assist with technical interviewing?

Sure, we offer tech interview services. Mobilunity’s top-tier e-commerce tech consultants will assess the tech skills of your candidates and give professional recommendations. 

Are there additional charges above the monthly pricing, e.g., a setup fee?

Mobilunity doesn’t charge a setup or other fees above the pre-agreed monthly price or Effective Daily Rate (EFD). However, we charge moderate overheads to run your engineers’ back-office support and retention. 

Will you manage my dedicated team?

No, our dedicated development teams model assumes your PM manages your e-commerce engineers and controls their performance. Mobilunity manages only HR, legal, accounting, IT infrastructure, and other back-office tasks related to your team.

What other services do your engineers offer?

Mobilunity’s eCommerce engineers can also host websites, containerize apps on Docker, create ecommerce solutions for startups, and perform CMS/ERP integration while applying advanced techniques to build feature-rich, scalable, and secure virtual stores.

What is the typical process for hiring a Magento developer through Mobilunity?

Our efficient procedure includes grasping your unique needs, finding and pre-screening suitable candidates, coordinating interviews, and supporting the onboarding process. Our goal is to connect you with the appropriate Magento developer in 3–6 weeks.

Is it possible to hire a Magento developer for a temporary project?

Yes, Mobilunity provides adaptable engagement models, featuring part-time Magento consultants for brief projects and devoted full-time developers for extended partnerships.

What are the costs associated with getting a Magento developer through Mobilunity?

The costs depend on various elements like the developer’s skill level and location, the complexity of the project. Mobilunity offers attractive pricing and collaborates with you to discover a solution that aligns with your budget.

In what ways do time zone variations impact collaboration with Mobilunity’s developers?

Developers we hire are experienced in collaborating with clients in different time zones and can modify their schedules to facilitate effective communication and cooperation.

What assistance does Mobilunity offer once a developer is employed?

In addition to the recruitment process, Mobilunity provides continuous back-office support, encompassing HR, legal, accounting, and IT services, so you can concentrate on project development while we manage administrative duties.
